name: ESBE Incorporated
description: WebMCP tool catalogue for esbeincorporated.org. These tools are registered in the browser via document.modelContext on every page of the site; this document lists them for discovery. Executable definitions ship in /webmcp-tools.js.

tools.name: get_page_guide
tools.description: List ESBE Incorporated's public pages (home, donate, community, va claim guide, nexus letter, privacy, terms) with each page's title, description, URL, and last-updated date, from the site's own page catalog.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the full text of ESBE Incorporated's public pages (home, donate, community, va claim guide, nexus letter, privacy, terms) and return matching excerpts with the page each came from.

query.description: Words to find across the site's pages, e.g. 'donate', 'veterans', 'Treasure Island'.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch one ESBE page's published content (title, sections, facts, links) as clean markdown: /, /donate, /community, /va-claim-guide, /nexus-letter, /privacy, or /terms.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the visitor's browser to one of ESBE Incorporated's public pages: home (/), donate (/donate), community (/community), va claim guide (/va-claim-guide), nexus letter (/nexus-letter), privacy (/privacy), or terms (/terms). Only these internal paths are used.

page.description: Destination: home, donate, community, va-claim-guide, nexus-letter, privacy, terms — or the exact path like /donate
